exactToolArguments.prompt:
Draw ONE NEW ORIGINAL ASHVEIL inventory icon: a single wearable pair of HUMAN LIGHT-SHADING PROTECTIVE GOGGLES. The first attached OWN material atlas is ONLY a reference for very dark salvaged optical glass and worn dull metal, NOT a source of full camera cylinders or parts to copy. The second attached OWN leather-belt icon is ONLY a brown leather/strap material reference. Draw wholly new original pixels. Rich restrained pixel-style dark fantasy salvage craft, muted steel/aged copper-grey wire edging and matte worn brown leather, not shiny steampunk jewellery or modern neon sports glasses.

The COMPLETE object is ONE human-sized pair of protective goggles with EXACTLY TWO separate very dark SMOKED GREY-GREEN/CHARCOAL LENSES, one for each eye, joined by a short physical nose bridge. Two low-profile round/oval lenses, nearly equal size with natural slight perspective, thin dull metal retaining rims, dark brown leather padded backing around the rims. A couple of small thin plate-metal SIDE SHIELDS attached at the two outer lens edges and turned slightly back to cover side-eye exposure; these plates are clearly solid metal, not extra lenses/ears/fins or a full helmet. The dark shaded glass has only a tiny restrained grey curved surface reflection, NOT clear transparent glass, a blue powered glow, red eyes, visible pupils, a heat-map/display, magic or light rays. Low-profile human eyewear, NOT two giant camera heads/barrels, a telescope, binoculars, a visor/one continuous lens, gas mask, medical face mask, helmet or animal goggles.

A REAL BROWN LEATHER HEAD STRAP must be FULLY VISIBLE BEHIND the two front lenses: a coherent continuous curved open loop running from one outer frame attachment around the rear to the other side, with one simple small dull metal adjustment buckle. The back strap crosses the upper/back part of the icon, clearly separate from the two front lenses; its open centre is TRUE TRANSPARENT empty space, not a hidden face/head or painted black blob. The strap is physical, not disconnected loose ribbons. Small rivet attachments, restrained creases and frayed leather edge; no long flapping loose ends, detached hardware or third lens. Keep the whole rear loop and buckle inside the silhouette, no clipping.

COMPOSITION: horizontal WIDE low3/4 perspective looking slightly down at the empty goggles, front lenses at lower/front and rear strap up/behind. This equipment belongs in a head slot and has a2columns x1row inventory footprint. A clearly wide approximately2:1 complete silhouette must remain readable at32x16 and64x32: both distinct dark lenses plus nose bridge plus rear leather strap and small side shield outlines. The whole object occupies at most60percent of square canvas width and35percent height; enormous true alpha-zero empty margins on every side. Make the pair, strap, bridge and side plates a single complete assembled object. No front lens obscured by the strap, no face/mannequin/person/head/eyes/hands, no ground/cast shadow/shadow disc, no backdrop/checkerboard, UI/frame/text/labels/logos, no glow/light effects or second object. Only the one complete original pair of unpowered shaded goggles on transparent PNG.
